head: Android 17 may keep audio in headphones when a car connects
dek: A hidden "Keep audio in headphones" setting in Android 17 QPR3 Beta 4, found by Android Authority, would stop sound from jumping to a car stereo or Bluetooth speaker when it connects. Google hasn't announced it, and it may not ship.
details: The toggle sits under Settings > Connected devices > Connection preferences. Its description says audio always plays in your headphones when speakers or cars connect. Android Authority had to switch it on by hand; it isn't visible in the beta. Apple added a similar option, Keep Audio with Headphones, in iOS 26.
where: Android 17 QPR3 Beta 4, hidden; no date
means: If your car takes over your earbuds' sound when you get in, Android may later let you stop that.
todo: Nothing to do yet; the setting is hidden even in the beta.
thumb_words: ANDROID 17 MAY KEEP AUDIO IN EARBUDS
